name: uop-attendance-server
comment:overrides: exceljs and gaxios both pin uuid 8/9, which carry GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq. Lifting the transitive copies to 11 clears it without touching exceljs itself -- `npm audit fix --force` would instead DOWNGRADE exceljs 4.4.0 -> 3.4.0 and take the attendance export with it. Safe because both consumers only ever destructure the named v4 export, which 11 still provides from CJS; the advisory is about v3/v5/v6 with an explicit buf.
